tabrion.comment: TABRION VER-1 (K-34): the one tabrion of every installation, a final version (RC-8). Every component (axentra, orkexa, nodestro-runtime, nodestro-api) requires it only by the same minor range, such as >=0.1,<0.2, never by a URL (RC-1, RC-2); the locks (platform/internal.txt and internal-server.txt; the studio profile too since TABRION MIG-NOD-3, K-32) hold its one commit. The libraries also pin this commit in requirements/tabrion.txt for their standalone install (RC-7). releases: the authoritative release commit of each final (no tags yet); only these commits count as finals.

axentra.comment: Generic SaaS backend library, server profile only (the nodestro-runtime[postgres] extra); the studio never depends on it.

products.comment: Released products and the studio commit each one builds from (their studio.json); updated when a product's studio.json moves. `candidate` is a built and checked release candidate that is not published.
